name: Bat Swarm
description:
If there is an Environment card already in play, discard it. This Environment remains in play until a new Environment is drawn.
Whenever a Hero attacks a Monster that is not on his or her tile, that Hero makes the attack roll twice and uses the lower result.

name: Blood Fog
description:
If there is an Environment card already in play, discard it. This Environment remains in play until a new Environment is drawn.
Whenever a Hero or a Monster attacks and rolls a natural 17 or higher, the target of the attack takes 1 additional damage.

name: Cackling Skull
description:
If there is an Environment card already in play, discard it. This Environment remains in play until a new Environment is drawn.
Whenever a Hero uses a Daily or Utility power, he or she takes 1 damage.

name: Crippling Miasma
description:
If there is an Environment card already in play, discard it. This Environment remains in play until a new Environment is drawn.
Each Hero's Speed is reduced by 1.

name: Deadly Shadows
description:
If there is an Environment card already in play, discard it. This Environment remains in play until a new Environment is drawn.
Whenever the active Hero ends his or her turn on a tile that has another Hero on it, the active Hero takes 1 damage.

name: Haunted Mists
description:
If there is an Environment card already in play, discard it. This Environment remains in play until a new Environment is drawn.
Undead Monsters gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

name: Music of the Damned
description:
If there is an Environment card already in play, discard it. This Environment remains in play until a new Environment is drawn.
Whenever a Hero would place a new Monster, that Hero draws two Monster Cards and chooses the Monster worth the most experience. He or she places that Monster and discards the other.

name: Spirit of Doom
description:
If there is an Environment card already in play, discard it. This Environment remains in play until a new Environment is drawn.
Whenever a Hero discards a Treasure Card, he or she takes 1 damage.

name: Bubbling Cauldron
description: Place each Monster 1 tile closer to the active Hero.

name: Corner of Your Eye
description:
Place the active Hero on an adjacent tile and roll the die:
1-15: A Monster rushes you from the darkness. Place a new Monster on the active Hero's tile.
16-20: A friendly spirit inspires you to fight on. Flip up one of your used powers.

name: Cowardly Flight
description: If there are no Monsters in play, discard this card. Draw a tile from the bottom of the Dungeon Tile stack and place it adjacent to the unexplored edge that is closest to the active Hero. Place the Monster closest to the active Hero on that tile, and place a new Monster on that tile. Do not draw an Encounter Card.

name: Cyrus Belview
description: Draw a tile from the bottom of the Dungeon Tile stack and place it adjacent to any unexplored edge. Place two new Monsters on that tile, then place the active Hero on that tile. Each other Hero can place himself or herself on the active Hero's new tile.

name: Frenzy
description: Each Monster you control activates twice during your Villain Phase.

name: Ghost of Prince Aurel
description: Flip over one unused Daily power or Utility power. If you don't have an unused power to flip over, take 1 damage instead.

name: Howl of the Wolf
description: Choose one Monster on any Hero's tile. That Monster immediately activates.

name: Illusionary Trick
description: The active Hero swaps positions with the Monster that is farthest from him or her.

name: Lief Lipsiege
description:
You try to distract Lief. Roll a die:
1-10: You scare Lief and he calls for help. Place a new Monster on the active Hero's tile.
11-20: Draw a Treasure Card.

name: Mists of Terror
description: Roll a die for each Hero. On a 1-5, the Hero takes 1 damage and is Immobilized.

name: Neglected Passage
description: If a Start tile is not in play, discard this card and draw a new Encounter Card. Draw a tile from the bottom of the Dungeon Tile stack and place it adjacent to the unexplored edge that is closest to the Start tile. Place a new Monster on that tile, but do not draw an Encounter Card.

name: Overrun
description: Each Hero takes damage equal to the number of Monsters he or she controls.

name: Overwhelming Terror
description: If a Start tile is not in play, discard this card and draw a new Encounter Card. Place each Hero 2 tiles closer to the Start tile. If a Hero is on the same tile as a Monster after being placed, that Hero is Slowed.

name: Passage of Time
description: Each Hero takes 1 damage.

name: Prowling Spirits
description: You must discard one of your Treasure Cards (of your choice).

name: Reinforcements
description: Choose the Hero controlling the fewest Monsters. That Hero places a new Monster on any tile with an unexplored edge.

name: Secret Door
description: Draw a tile from the bottom of the Dungeon Tile stack and place it adjacent to the unexplored edge that is closest to the active Hero. Place a new Monster on that tile, but do not draw an Encounter Card.

name: Spirit of Doom
description: Each Hero can immediately move up to his or her Speed. After this move, each Hero on a tile with no Monsters takes 1 damage.

name: Strahd's Hunger
description: Choose the Hero with the most Hit Points remaining. That Hero takes 1 damage and is Immobilized.

name: Strahd's Minions
description: Place the active Hero and the two Monsters that are closest to that Hero on the tile farthest from the active Hero. If there are less than two Monsters in play, place a new Monster adjacent to the active Hero after he or she is placed.

name: Strahd's Trick
description: Place the active Hero on a tile within 1 tile of you that has the most Monsters on it. If no tile within 1 tile of you has Monsters, the active Hero takes 1 damage.

name: Strahd's Whispers
description: Place the active Hero adjacent to the next closest Hero. The active Hero attacks that Hero with an at-will power.

name: Summoning Circle
description: Place a new Monster adjacent to the active Hero.

name: Teleport Glyph
description: Place the active Hero and each Monster on his or her tile on the tile farthest from the active Hero.

name: Treasure Chest
description:
You open a treasure chest. Roll a die:
1-10: Take 2 damage.
11-15: Take 1 damage and draw 1 Treasure Card.
16-20: Draw 1 Treasure Card.

name: Voice of the Master
description: Starting with the Hero on your left, each Hero immediately activates one Monster he or she controls. The first Hero that cannot activate a Monster instead places a new Monster on any tile.

name: Ambush!
description: Attack each Hero on the active Hero's tile. +8 / Slowed. Place a new Monster on the active Hero's tile.

name: Animated Armor
description: Attack each Hero on the active Hero's tile. +7 / 3 (Miss: 1 Damage).

name: Circle of Death
description: Attack each Hero on the active Hero's tile. +8 / 2 (Miss: 1 Damage). Each Undead Monster on the active Hero's tile regains 1 Hit Point.

name: Gray Ooze
description: Attack the active Hero. +8 / 3 (Miss: 1 Damage). If the active Hero is hit by the attack, the active Hero discards 1 Treasure Card at random.

name: Green Slime
description: Attack each Hero on the active Hero's tile. +6 / 2 (Miss: 1 Damage). If the active Hero is hit by the attack, the active Hero discards 1 Treasure Card at random.

name: Hands of the Dead
description: Attack each Hero on the active Hero's tile. +6 / 2 (Miss: 1 Damage). If a Hero is hit by the attack, the Hero is slowed.

name: Howling Ghost
description: Attack each Hero on the active Hero's tile. +9 / 2. A Hero hit by this attack can flip an unused Daily power over to prevent this damage.

name: Icy Corridor
description: Attack each Hero on the active Hero's tile. +8 / 2 (Miss: 1 Damage). After the attack, place each Hero on the active Hero's tile on a tile within 1 tile of the active Hero's tile. (Heroes can be placed on different tiles.)

name: King Tomescu's Portal
description: Attack the active Hero three times. +8 / 1. Remove the active Hero from his or her tile. At the start of that Hero's next Hero Phase, place that Hero on any tile.

name: Patrina Velikovna
description: Attack each Hero. +7 / 2 (Miss: 1 Damage). After the attack, place each Monster that is not on the same tile as a Hero 1 tile closer to the closest Hero.

name: Prowling Ghost
description: Attack the active Hero. +9 / 1. After the attack, draw a tile from the bottom of the Dungeon Tile stack and place it adjacent to the unexplored edge that is closest to the active Hero. Place a new Monster on that tile, and then place the active Hero on that tile.

name: Spider Webs
description: Attack the active Hero. +4 / Immobilized (Miss: Slowed).

name: Strahd Attacks!
description: Attack each Hero within 1 tile of the active Hero. +6 / 3 (Miss: 1 Damage).

name: Alarm
description:
Place the Alarm marker on the active Hero's tile. If that tile already has a marker, discard this card and draw a new Encounter Card.
Trigger the Trap during your Villain Phase: Place a new Monster on the unexplored edge that is closest to the Alarm marker.
Instead of attacking, a Hero on a tile with a Trap can try to disable it. DISABLE: Roll 10+

name: Crossbow Turret
description:
Place the Crossbow Turret marker on the active Hero's tile. If that tile already has a marker, discard this card and draw a new Encounter Card.
Trigger the Trap during your Villain Phase: Attack each Hero within 1 tile of this Trap. +8 / 2 (Miss: 1 Damage).
Instead of attacking, a Hero on a tile with a Trap can try to disable it. DISABLE: Roll 10+

name: Crushing Walls
description:
Place the Crushing Walls marker on the active Hero's tile. If that tile already has a marker, discard this card and draw a new Encounter Card.
Trigger the Trap during your Villain Phase: Attack each Hero on this tile. +6 / 2 and Immobilized (Miss: 1 Damage).
Instead of attacking, a Hero on a tile with a Trap can try to disable it. DISABLE: Roll 10+

name: Dart Trap
description:
Place the Dart Trap marker on the active Hero's tile. If that tile already has a marker, discard this card and draw a new Encounter Card.
Trigger the Trap during your Villain Phase: Attack each Hero on this tile. +8 / 2 (Miss: 1 Damage).
Instead of attacking, a Hero on a tile with a Trap can try to disable it. DISABLE: Roll 10+

name: Fire Trap
description:
Place the Fire Trap marker on the active Hero's tile. If that tile already has a marker, discard this card and draw a new Encounter Card.
Trigger the Trap during your Villain Phase: Each Hero on this tile takes 2 damage.
Instead of attacking, a Hero on a tile with a Trap can try to disable it. DISABLE: Roll 10+

name: Sliding Walls
description:
Place the Sliding Walls marker on the active Hero's tile. If that tile already has a marker, discard this card and draw a new Encounter Card.
Trigger the Trap during your Villain Phase: Roll the die for each Hero on this tile and place that Hero on a tile within 1 tile of this Trap in the direction indicated by the Sliding Walls marker. If the direction rolled is a wall or an unexplored tile, the Hero takes 1 damage and remains on this tile.
Instead of attacking, a Hero on a tile with a Trap can try to disable it. DISABLE: Roll 10+

name: Spear Gauntlet
description:
Place the Spear Gauntlet marker on the active Hero's tile. If that tile already has a marker, discard this card and draw a new Encounter Card.
Trigger the Trap during your Villain Phase: Attack each Hero within 1 tile of this Trap. +6 / 3 (Miss: 1 Damage).
Instead of attacking, a Hero on a tile with a Trap can try to disable it. DISABLE: Roll 10+
